verdict_note: Strong cross-functional operator with proven GTM and partnership execution at scale, but lacks direct strategic partnerships and product integration experience that OpenAI prioritizes.

breakdown.note: Manager-level experience confirmed (AGM, Senior PM). Role expects 10+ years; candidate has 8 professional + ongoing MBA. Seniority sufficient but not overstated.

Strong on cross-functional coordination, P&L ownership, strategic roadmap alignment, and relationship management. Missing: formal partnerships experience, technical product integrations, deal structure negotiation, revenue/adoption tracking at partnership level.

EdTech SaaS background translates to high-growth B2C and B2B2C motion. OpenAI role requires platform partnerships and AI ecosystem thinking. GEO research is adjacent but not direct partnership experience.

Demonstrated ability to own P&L, scale operations (60+ team at BYJU'S), drive revenue (5M+), improve conversion (38-42% uplifts). No explicit track record of managing multi-year strategic partnerships or product integrations.

Requires H1B sponsorship. OpenAI is a large, well-funded company likely capable of sponsoring, but JD does not explicitly state sponsorship availability. Visa requirement is a material friction point.

top_signal: P&L ownership across 5 city markets with revenue accountability, proven ability to align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, sales, operations), and demonstrated track record of scaling operations and driving high-impact growth initiatives in fast-moving environments.
biggest_gap: No direct experience managing multi-year strategic partnerships, product integrations, or complex deal structures; OpenAI role centers on partnership portfolio ownership and technical/commercial deal negotiation, which are not prominently evidenced in candidate's background. Additionally, visa sponsorship requirement adds recruitment friction at a large (but still selective) company.
